sites.name: IM-2 Athena — Mons Mouton

source.title: LROC: IM-2 Athena: A Closer View (final position 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E, in ~20 m crater)

sites.notes: Final position from LROC. Came to rest on its side in a ~20 m crater on Mons Mouton, about 250 m from the intended site; the mission ended about 12 h 45 min after landing. Landing time is APPROXIMATE (reported as ~12:30 p.m. EST; the UTC time is our conversion, the date 2025-03-06 is sourced).

sites.name: Apollo 12

source.title: NSSDCA Apollo LM landing site coordinates (LRO-derived, Wagner et al. 2017, DE421 mean Earth/polar axis)

sites.notes: LM descent stage position from LRO images, planetocentric, longitude converted from NSSDCA east-positive value. Time derived by us: SP-4214 App. 5 lists the landing time in Eastern Standard Time (footnote a); UTC = EST + 5 h. NASA SP-4012 chronology gives 1:54:35, so +/-1 s. Landing time precision: to the second; derived from EST.
